warning.titlePre: Jaguar XF 3.0d Oil Leaks & Coolant System Wear
paragraphs: The Ford AJD V6 is a sophisticated 3.0-litre inline-six with an integrated starter-generator and electric auxiliary compressor — a more modern and efficient design than the older Ford AJD V6 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every Ford AJD V6 rebuild.
Because the XF 3.0d uses a completely different engine family from the V8 M178 fitted to the XF 63 and GT 63 S, parts and rebuild specifications don't cross over between them.
warning.source: Source: Established Ford AJD V6 specialist pattern — timing chain, bearing and gasket wear across integrated-starter-generator inline-six units.
